Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just reading some of the old Space Adventure issues.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Upside-down?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Issue 98. The crew ends up on a planet with reverse gravity.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Buford. Where's Baljeet?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? Ya think I keep a detailed schedule of everything he does?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gets out a book labeled "Baljeet Chronicles, Volume V") All right, fine. (opens the book and puts on his reading glasses) Let's see. Tuesday, 9:00 am, Phineas and Ferb's backyard. He's late, but it's on here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Please help! The situation I am in is quite dire!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There is a new Space Adventure movie filming in Danville. (takes out a poster) The Namrak Necroslug. And I have been invited to audition!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How'd you land that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: By chance. I ran into the director, Katherine Marshall, and she thought I would fit a particular role. A character called "Exterra".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He sounds awesome!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughing) Yes, he does! But there is still one problem. I do not know how to act. I have a hard time pretending.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What if we help set the scene for you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, that's it! If we bring the ice jungles of Namrak to life, Baljeet won't have to pretend. He can experience it for real! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs, puts on headphones) No better way to listen to the Lumberzacks than on repeat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice animatronics, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (to the Fireside Girls) Come on, ladies, those Prop Design Patches won't iron earn themselves!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And why is Buford filming this?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You can use it for your audition, and I can use it for my reel. (An assistant gives him a cup of coffee.) Thanks, Shane.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That does not explain how you got an assistant.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: (loudly) Wine glass delivery for "P. Platypus"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello there, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz's brother, Roger, is having another commemorative statue of himself— (scoffs) If I had a nickel for every time that's happened...

Name: Carl
Dialog: You'd have two nickels, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, yes, I know how it goes, Carl. Anyhoo, the mayor is the public face of Danville. Do not let Doofenshmirtz ruin the ceremony.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, come in, come in. I consider you a VIP, a very important platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) And now you're imprisoned by your own celebrity. Now I suppose you're wondering why I have this large papier-mâché version of my own head. Don't worry, it will come into play soon. You see, ever since I was little, people have always forgotten my face. I was even voted Least Recognizable in high school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, that's not even me! It's a traffic cone with a dent in it! I mean, I don't think that's me. (puts down the yearbook and carries his trapped nemesis) On the other hand, Roger has the most recognizable face in all of Danville. He's got that je ne sais quois. And I would know. I minored in sais quois.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's do this beholding al fresco, shall we?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, my deface-inator! One blast and your face becomes incredibly forgettable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Once I zap Roger, nobody will recognize him and his unveiling will be a failing! Y'know, I'm... I'm gonna switch it back. This is too disturbing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There ya go, papier-mâché me, don't let anybody tell ya you look like a traffic cone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, crew. A new day, a new adventure. A Space Adventure!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, I can see these vines are just painted ropes. How can I act with this?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya might be overthinkin' it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yeah, it's just that...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (spoken, recitative) Well, that is a tuba, that is a chair.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That one over there is Buford covered in hair

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is a toy, this is a Styrofoam prop,

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And this is a beautifully rendered backdrop

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That garden gnome has been sprayed with chrome

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What? I recognize it from your home!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is hard for me to make believe,

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When that alien has corn chip teeth

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am trying!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (to Ferb) That is ketchup on your sleeve!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my goodness, is this Candace's bed? How did you get it down the stairs?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Baljeet's really struggling to get into his character.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What else could we do to help?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait! I've got an idea! Release the Necroslug!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The Namrak Necroslug?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know I can tell this is an animatronic, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just go along with it. If you want people to believe your performance, you've gotta believe in it yourself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Captain Dirk, the Necroslug seems to have spotted us!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (unenthusiastically) Perhaps we should flee before it hunts us down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, let's try turning the aggression up. Buford, bump it up to a seven.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, I put it on eleven.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, we said seven, not eleven!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've never even tested that level of aggression!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's gonna eat us all!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, do not be so overdramatic.

Name: Shane
Dialog: Here's your coffee, sir.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: See? It only ate Shane. But to be fair, it might not be finished yet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, new plan. Run!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Roger. Prepare to lose face.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (whispering) I think we lost it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, what happened to Ferb? Who's this guy?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I am Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dude, whoever you are, that's a great impression. But where did Ferb go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I should really build an auto-aim-inator, because I cannot hit the broad side of a barn.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Um, hello? Can we discuss the bigger problem? And by "bigger problem", I mean "THE BERSERK NECROSLUG THAT IS ON THE LOOSE"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run again!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How do we stop it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: There's a control doohickey on its head. If we smash it, it should be lights out for the big guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet, you and Isabella distract the Necroslug. (referring to Ferb) This guy and I can use these vines to make a trap. Buford can smash the doohickey.

Name: Assistant
Dialog: And here it is, just like I told you. I found your ice jungle, Miss Marshall.

Name: Katherine Marshall
Dialog: You know what? This is great. Y'know, it's starting to make me think that maybe the Tri-State Area has more to offer than just tax credits.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Guys, out of time! How's the net?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not sure it'll hold!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It better, or we're getting a VIP tour of that Necroslug's bowels!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think perhaps you are using the term "VIP" incorrectly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: C'mon, Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (throws net down) Buford, now!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm ready for my close-up!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Man down! Me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The net won't hold!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (screams) Exterra, you're our only hope!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The luck of Shluffbaum is with me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps and dials the phone) Mom, Mom! Alien jungle! Giant slug!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Mom, alien jungle! Giant slug! Mom! Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's too late, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Mayor's Aide
Dialog: And now, presenting, the face of Danville...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Roger's statue still got messed up. I'm gonna call that a win.

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: It's so simple, like it could represent any one of us.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: It's just like humble old Roger to make his statue about celebrating the common man.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Uh, yes. Exactly as I intended.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: We're all the face of Danville!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, did I just help Roger's reputation? (goes to the inator) I can undo it. I can still undo it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, now I have to clean this all up! You couldn't just hit the self-destruct button? That would've been better.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs triumphantly) I have conquered the great beast! I am Exterra!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And... cut! Good work, today, Sluggy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, Sluggy?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, Baljeet, but we had to keep it a secret to get you into character.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You were all acting? This was all staged?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was Buford's idea. He knew if you believed the situation was real, you'd believe in yourself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (puts arm around Baljeet) I knew you'd rise to the occasion, pal. You just needed a little push. (shoves Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: All right, that one was for me.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh. Deception aside, my confidence is at an all-time high. Exterra fears nothing! (yelps)

Name: Katherine Marshall
Dialog: I-I-It's "Baljeet", right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Renowned director Katherine Marshall?

Name: Katherine Marshall
Dialog: That was simply incredible! I mean, it's like watching a true star in the making. Am I right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So I get the part? (hands flyer to Marshall) I get to be Exterra?

Name: Katherine Marshall
Dialog: "Exterra"? (takes the flyer) Um... Oh, this is a typo. We were looking for extras. You know, for background work. When I saw you in town, I was just amazed how well you just blended into the background. But then that heroic image of you, I just can't get it out of my head. I can't hire you as an extra now, and we already hired all the leads, so I don't think I can use you anymore.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All of that work and all in vain. If only there was some way to go back to being forgettable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) What'm I supposed to do with this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Ferb! Ugh! That other guy talked too much.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, if I am good enough to impress the Katherine Marshall, maybe my acting talents are worth cultivating. Maybe I should take a class. Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (writes in the Baljeet Chronicles) Already ahead of ya! Yeah, he's free Wednesday at 8:00.

Name: Katherine Marshall
Dialog: Oh, by the way, this set is incredible. Would it happen to be for sale?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, no, but you can just have it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, come to the backyard! The boys are at it again!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sighs) At this point, I should just have Buford add this to my schedule.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! Mom! Hurry, hurry, hurry! Wait till you see it! Come on, come on, come on, come on! (The backyard is empty.) Uh, what?!?! Anybody needs me, then I'll be on the couch. (She walks back inside.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, has anybody seen Shane?

Name: Shane
Dialog: Hello? Mr. Buford? I'm still in the slug.

Name: Shane
Dialog: If it ain't broken, no need to fix it.
